_help: Two ways to add a Screener.in screen. 1) 'screens' = raw queries run directly. 2) 'savedScreens' = screens you built/saved in the Screener.in UI, referenced by their FULL url (copy it from the browser address bar — the id alone 404s). Both are fetched from your logged-in session, so private screens work too. Run login-screener.bat once, then fetch-screener.bat.

screens.label: Quality + Fast
screens.note: Quality-that-yields-fast: profitable, growing, low-debt companies already trending up near their highs. Feeds Confluence (Screener.in source) + Sniper (fundamental kicker).
screens.query: Market Capitalization > 1000 AND Return on capital employed > 18 AND Return on equity > 15 AND Debt to equity < 0.5 AND Sales growth 3Years > 12 AND Profit growth 3Years > 12 AND Current price > DMA 200 AND Current price > 0.85 * High price

screens.label: MB Durability
screens.note: Your refined multibagger formula, kept EXACTLY as specified. Its teeth: >25.9% EPS CAGR simultaneously over 10/7/5/3 years (serial-compounder durability), plus Piotroski>6 and ROCE>15 — three tests the MBF score had no data for. Feeds Factor 7 (Durability) on the multibagger page at full weight. NOTE: in Screener.in, 'Operating profit'/'Net profit' are absolute ₹Cr (a ₹10Cr floor), not margins — swap to 'OPM > 10' if you meant margin %.
screens.query: EPS growth 10Years > 25.9 AND EPS growth 7Years > 25.9 AND EPS growth 5Years > 25.9 AND EPS growth 3Years > 25.9 AND Market Capitalization < 5000 AND Sales growth 10Years > 15 AND Operating profit > 10 AND Net profit > 10 AND Return on equity > 15 AND Return on capital employed > 15 AND Debt to equity < 0.5 AND Piotroski score > 6

screens.label: MB Durability T2
screens.note: Graded tier-2 of the durability test: same shape, looser bars (>20% EPS CAGR across 10/7/5/3Y, Piotroski>5, OPM% instead of an absolute profit floor) and market-cap floored to 500-15000Cr so every hit is actually NSE-tradeable at retail size. Awards partial Factor 7 credit, so durability scores in tiers instead of pass/fail.
screens.query: EPS growth 10Years > 20 AND EPS growth 7Years > 20 AND EPS growth 5Years > 20 AND EPS growth 3Years > 20 AND Market Capitalization > 500 AND Market Capitalization < 15000 AND Sales growth 10Years > 12 AND OPM > 10 AND Return on equity > 15 AND Return on capital employed > 15 AND Debt to equity < 0.6 AND Piotroski score > 5

screens.label: MB Durability Trend
screens.note: The strict durability formula PLUS 'Current price > DMA 200'. Deliberately kept as a SEPARATE screen rather than folded into MB Durability: a proven compounder trading below its 200-DMA is a buy-the-dip candidate, and during a market correction a trend-gated quality screen would empty out exactly when the best long-term entries appear. Membership only sets a visible ⚡ uptrend flag on the durability badge — it awards NO extra points, because MBF Factor 5 (Price Momentum) already scores price vs the 200-DMA. Filters AND; scores ADD.
screens.query: EPS growth 10Years > 25.9 AND EPS growth 7Years > 25.9 AND EPS growth 5Years > 25.9 AND EPS growth 3Years > 25.9 AND Market Capitalization < 5000 AND Sales growth 10Years > 15 AND Operating profit > 10 AND Net profit > 10 AND Return on equity > 15 AND Return on capital employed > 15 AND Debt to equity < 0.5 AND Piotroski score > 6 AND Current price > DMA 200

savedScreens.label: YouTube Screener
savedScreens.note: Your saved 'YouTube based screener'. Full url required (id alone 404s). A stock in BOTH this and Quality+Fast scores higher (multi-screen fundamental overlap).
